name: RWA World Heavyweight Title
epitaph: Nuke and Trent Malady fought the vacant title to a 30-minute draw in the fed's own tournament final; Malady won it outright the following week in a Triple Threat, and retained it by DQ against Axon Blade before Da Messiah's own interference handed it to Nuke off-page. Kontra took it from Nuke in a Scaffold Match staged as payback for that same interference, and stands as the fed's own last-attested champion on its served Rankings page.

name: RWA U.S. Heavyweight Title
epitaph: Drake Martel won the vacant title in a short-notice tournament final against Death Jester, sabotaged by BeefCarver and the Crow's own revenge attack, and retained it against Deadpool. Bishop stands as the fed's own last-attested champion on its served Rankings page — an off-page title change the corpus does not otherwise record.

name: RWA World Television Title
epitaph: Chronos swept a four-man-plus tournament for the vacant title, beating Canadian Homeboy in the final. Axon Blade stands as the fed's own last-attested champion on its served Rankings page — an off-page title change the corpus does not otherwise record.

name: RWA World Tag Team Title
epitaph: Pleasure & Paine held the title entering the fed's own served corpus, its own start not recorded. Body Count (Sammie Curr and RIP) won it from them at Friday Night Fury (1/31) and stand as the fed's own last-attested champions on its served Rankings page.
